# Gelabber v0.6.1

Fixes for v0.6.0 on `main`, reviewed in #210, #211, #212, #213, #214, #215,
#216, #217, #218 and #219.

**Operators: read "Upgrade notes" first.** coturn must be recreated together
with the API after TURN values change, and attachment links are now cached
for up to 60 minutes.

## Calls

- Leaving a voice channel releases the call audio: the tab no longer shows
  "playing audio" afterwards (#210, fixes #209).
- Joining without a usable microphone says "Kein Mikrofon gefunden, du hörst
  nur zu." instead of the browser's English reason. A failed microphone
  switch says that the call goes on with the previous microphone (#210).
- A microphone prompt still open while the media connection reconnects no
  longer loses the microphone silently: the answer carries over to the new
  connection without a second prompt, and a failure is reported (#212,
  fixes #203).
- Go Live while someone else is live: the button is dimmed and says
  "<Name> ist gerade live." on hover and on press instead of doing nothing
  (#211, fixes #202). A Live claimed by someone else at the same moment
  (refused by the gateway) shows the same message, and the button keeps
  keyboard focus when the roster changes (#219).

## Chat

- Loading older messages keeps the row you are reading in place instead of
  jumping; the chat stays at the bottom after new messages and keeps its
  position when you have scrolled up (#215, fixes #201).
- Images sit in a fixed 240 px box, so rows no longer reflow when they load.
- A click on an image opens a lightbox (Esc or "Schließen" closes it) instead
  of a new tab. "Herunterladen" there, and on file attachments, really
  downloads the file and keeps the app open.
- Attachment links are signed per 30-minute window and cached by the browser,
  so the same image is no longer downloaded again on every render (see
  "Upgrade notes" for the access consequence).
- The unread snapshot (`GET /messages/unread`) is no longer requested on every
  window focus: focus, visibility and the 15 s poll refresh only a snapshot
  older than 10 s. Measured locally: 2 requests instead of 7 for the same
  clicks (#213, fixes #207).

## Profile and avatars

- "Bild hochladen" and "Entfernen" in the profile. The picture is cropped to
  a centred 256×256 square in the browser (WebP, or JPEG/PNG where the
  browser cannot encode WebP, e.g. Safari and the Linux app) and stored by
  the API itself, so viewers no longer load avatars from third-party sites
  (#218, refs #208).
- Uploads are limited to 512 KiB of PNG, JPEG or WebP (no SVG), count against
  the upload rate, and are served to signed-in users only. A replaced or
  removed upload is deleted.
- Avatar links still work and are now loaded without a referrer. Existing
  link avatars keep loading from their sites until the user uploads a
  picture; #208 stays open for that part.

## Interface

- The user menu and the channel "create" menu close on Esc, on a press
  outside and once an entry is chosen (#214, part of #205).
- Unknown paths show a "Seite nicht gefunden" page with a link home. A server
  link that does not exist or is not yours says "Server nicht gefunden oder
  kein Zugriff." before going home.
- Settings: own icons for Darstellung, Themes and App, App moved to the end,
  call sounds only under Audio, the bandwidth saver under Video and Audio,
  "Geräte laden" renamed "Geräteliste aktualisieren", mic gain shows
  0 / 100 / 200 %. The profile gets "Zurück" like the settings, and a
  visible "Noch nichts geändert" next to its disabled "Speichern".
- The empty DM list and the empty server sidebar point at creating a server
  or opening an invite; the create-a-server hint no longer flashes before the
  server list has loaded.

## Desktop apps

- No desktop changes since v0.6.0: the Linux and Windows apps are rebuilt
  with the version 0.6.1 and load the server's web client as before. Arch:
  `yay -Syu` brings the update.

## Operation

- `deploy/compose/turn-check.sh` compares the TURN values the running API and
  coturn were started with and names the keys that differ, without printing
  them. A mismatch looked like a call that connects without sound (#216,
  fixes #200). The documented rollout now recreates coturn too.
- The API logs a warning at startup when `MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT` is an
  `https://` URL with a port other than 443, and `deploy/README.md` describes
  moving MinIO to its own subdomain (#217, fixes #206).

## Upgrade notes

- **No database migrations.** The image set (`GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE`)
  moves to `v0.6.1` together; do not mix an API, web or media image from
  another version. No `.env` changes are required.
- **Production servers that follow `latest` through Watchtower update as soon
  as the `Release` workflow moves the `latest` aliases.** Make a backup
  first (`deploy/backup.sh`, see "Backup" in `deploy/README.md`) or pause
  Watchtower until you are ready.
- **After changing TURN values in `.env`** (`TURN_AUTH_SECRET`,
  `TURN_USERNAME`, `TURN_PASSWORD`) recreate coturn and the API together and
  check them. Watchtower and `up … api` keep coturn's old environment:

  ```bash
  cd deploy/compose
  # Homelab overlay without COMPOSE_PROFILES=bundled-coturn: leave out `coturn`
  # (naming it starts the bundled one) and update your own TURN server instead.
  docker compose up -d --no-deps --force-recreate coturn api
  ./turn-check.sh
  ```

  For a digest rollout use the same `--env-file` / `-f` arguments as the
  rollout (`deploy/README.md`, "After changing TURN values" and "Rollout and
  rollback with exact digests").
- **MinIO on a port other than 443** (for example
  `MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT=https://example.com:9000`) now causes a startup
  warning. Networks that allow only 80/443 load no images there. Move MinIO
  to its own subdomain as described in `deploy/README.md`, "Behind TLS" →
  "MinIO on 443". Keep the old port reachable for about 30 minutes after the
  switch, as described there, because open browsers keep following cached
  links to it.
- **Attachment links can now be cached for up to 60 minutes** (before: 60 s).
  Someone removed from a channel can keep loading attachment links they
  already hold for up to 60 minutes. New links are refused at once, because
  the API checks membership before every redirect.
- **Rollback to v0.6.0** is possible and touches no schema; the Caddyfile and
  `compose.yaml` did not change. Afterwards:
  - uploaded avatars show the user's initials;
  - a user with an uploaded avatar can save their profile again only after
    clearing the avatar field, because v0.6.0 accepts only `https://` there.
    Alternatively run
    `UPDATE users SET avatar_url = NULL WHERE avatar_url LIKE '/api/avatars/%'`;
  - the avatar objects stay in the bucket; cleanup rows that are due are
    still deleted correctly by the older worker.

## Open

- Not tested on physical devices: iOS/WebKit and Android phones, the Linux
  and Windows desktop apps with this release's web client.
- The chat-scroll fix is guarded by a local Chromium smoke test
  (`npm run test:chat-scroll-smoke`) that does not run in CI; the lightbox's
  dialog and focus behaviour are not covered by automated tests.
- Existing link avatars still load from third-party sites (#208).
- The open items listed for v0.6.0 remain.
